acquisition method: The MS analysis was performed in a data-dependent manner with full scans (m/z 300–1400)
cleavage agent: Tryptic peptides were dissolved with 10 μl of loading buffer
collision energy: All the tandem mass spectra were acquired using the higher-energy collision dissociation (HCD) method with normalized collision energy of 27%.
enrichment method: Distinct isoforms of CCAR1 were immunoprecipitated with Protein A-G agarose from A549 cells
fragmentation method: All the tandem mass spectra were acquired using the higher-energy collision dissociation (HCD) method
instrument: The samples from in-gel digestion were analyzed on a Q-Exactive HF MS (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
labeling: The samples from in-gel digestion were analyzed on a Q-Exactive HF MS
mass analyzer: acquired using an Orbitrap mass analyzer at a mass resolution of 120,000
precursor tolerance: The mass tolerance of the precursor ions was set to 20 p.p.m.
fragment tolerance: For the tolerance of the product ions, QE HF was set to 50 mmu.
ptm: N-terminal protein acetylation and methionine oxidation were set as variable modifications.
